dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are your travels through Liyue going?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Great! The ruins and history are fascinating, as are the local customs.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: I mean, a lot of local customs are also derived from history. I've learned a lot just from studying them.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Take, for example, this particular record of Liyue wedding customs, which was written about in Customs of Liyue: Flower Ball by a scholar from Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If it interests you, do take it and have a look. It's very fascinating indeed.
